This Terraform configuration creates an AWS SageMaker Notebook Instance and configures it to clone the GitHub repository `https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws.git` into the notebook environment when the instance starts. It includes:

- AWS provider configuration in `us-east-1`
- IAM role for SageMaker
- IAM policy attachments required for SageMaker notebook execution
- SageMaker lifecycle configuration to clone the GitHub repository
- SageMaker notebook instance using the lifecycle configuration
